description: Browser watchlist. Editable: limits and the format rules that decide what counts as vinyl. discogsCheckHours: how often the watch page asks Discogs whether an imported list changed (one light request per list); discogsStaleDays: after this, an unchanged list is still offered a resync. radio: a Radio4000 radio's tracks are kept in the browser (maxTracks at most) and read again only from the newest, in full every fullEveryDays; maxCandidates records per track to review.
